## Klaviyo Bounce Monitor
**Flow:** Schedule → Config → pull campaigns (last N days) → delivery stats → hard/soft bounce split → evaluate thresholds → Slack summary.

**Demo mode:** Config points at the local mock Klaviyo server (`mock_klaviyo_server.py`) and its `/slack` endpoint — the whole flow executes with zero credentials.

**Go live:** in Config set `klaviyoBaseUrl` to `https://a.klaviyo.com`, paste a private API key, and set `slackWebhookUrl` to a real incoming webhook. Nothing else changes.
